services.name: llama-cpp-5090
services.note: RTX 5090 (fixed card); router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/5090; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: llama-cpp-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti (fixed card); router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/4070ti; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: llama-cpp-both
services.note: RTX 5090 + RTX 4070 Ti layer split (5090 main); exclusive: starting it stops every other GPU service incl. strata, and any GPU start stops it; router over ~/.local/share/llama.cpp/cards/both; every request needs a key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt

services.name: maya-5090-256
services.note: Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash on the RTX 5090 alone (Maya-S-v2 IQ2_XXS pack), 262,144-token context; one maya variant at a time (same container name and port 11440); exclusive: starting it stops every GPU service (strata has nowhere to move); the dashboard/API need no key by default -- set MAYA_API_KEY to change

services.name: maya-5090-512
services.note: Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash on the RTX 5090 alone (Maya-S-v2 IQ2_XXS pack), 524,288-token context; otherwise as maya-5090-256

services.name: maya-5090-1024
services.note: Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash on the RTX 5090 alone (Maya-S-v2 IQ2_XXS pack), 1,048,576-token context; otherwise as maya-5090-256

services.name: maya-both-256
services.note: Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash on both cards, layer split (Maya-S24 pack, ~11% faster decode), 262,144-token context; the 4070 Ti holds ~11.5 GB of experts; otherwise as maya-5090-256

services.name: maya-both-512
services.note: Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash on both cards, layer split (Maya-S24 pack), 524,288-token context; otherwise as maya-both-256

services.name: maya-both-1024
services.note: Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash on both cards, layer split (Maya-S24 pack), 1,048,576-token context (measured: 30-37 tok/s, expert cache 67-70%); otherwise as maya-both-256

services.name: strata-5090
services.note: RTX 5090, 256K context; one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; may run beside strata-coder (duo); LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-5090-524k
services.note: RTX 5090, 524,288-token context (YaRN rope scaling x2, experimental upstream; measured: a 517K-token prompt read in 100 s); otherwise as strata-5090

services.name: strata-5090-1m
services.note: RTX 5090, 1,048,576-token context (YaRN rope scaling x4, experimental upstream; measured: a 1.02M-token prompt read in 248 s, ~75 GB RAM); otherwise as strata-5090

services.name: strata-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti; one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-4070ti-524k
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti, 512K (524,288)-token context (YaRN rope scaling x2, experimental upstream; KV streams from RAM); otherwise as strata-4070ti

services.name: strata-4070ti-1m
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti, 1M (1,048,576)-token context (YaRN rope scaling x4, experimental upstream; KV streams from RAM); otherwise as strata-4070ti

services.name: strata-both
services.note: RTX 5090 + RTX 4070 Ti (layer split); one strata variant at a time (same port + container name); strata owns its card(s): scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves/stops other GPU services; LAN bind, every request requires the API key; built from ~/workspace/github.com/Niko1221/Strata

services.name: strata-coder
services.note: Strata Coder (GSQ-RCO Coder IQ1_M, 256K context; group coder: one coder variant at a time) on the RTX 4070 Ti; runs beside a 5090 strata variant (duo: `ai-lab strata duo`); owns the 4070 Ti like strata, cannot move: other 4070 Ti services stop it; pinned to the last 8 CPUs, the 5090 variants to the rest; same API key as strata

services.name: strata-coder-128k
services.note: Strata Coder at 128K (131,072)-token context with 4 batch slots ("parallel": 4): four conversations decode together; otherwise as strata-coder (same container name and port 11439). The 256K coder runs with 2 slots; 524K/1M stay at one at a time.

services.name: strata-coder-524k
services.note: Strata Coder at 512K (524,288)-token context (YaRN x2, experimental upstream); otherwise as strata-coder (same container name and port 11439)

services.name: strata-coder-1m
services.note: Strata Coder at 1M (1,048,576)-token context (YaRN x4, experimental upstream); otherwise as strata-coder (same container name and port 11439)

services.name: rizzo
services.note: Rizzo Flow local Jev-compatible System One decisions (POST /v1/systemone); llama.cpp CUDA on 4070 Ti; built from containers/rizzo-flow/

services.name: comfyui-5090
services.note: RTX 5090; runs on the card strata is not on (scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves it); one variant at a time, same port + container name

services.name: comfyui-4070ti
services.note: RTX 4070 Ti; runs on the card strata is not on (scripts/gpu-arbiter.py moves it); one variant at a time, same port + container name

services.name: docling-cpu
services.note: CPU variant of docling-serve (document conversion API for the docling MCP); loopback-only; one docling variant at a time (same container name + port 3108)

services.name: docling-4070ti
services.note: docling-serve CUDA 13 on the RTX 4070 Ti (Ada sm_89); shares the card with strata-coder/4070ti services: the arbiter moves/stops per the GPU rules; loopback-only; same port + container name as docling-cpu

services.name: sketchlab
services.note: same-origin /v1 AI proxy -> strata (key injected by nginx from config/sketchlab/service.env); boot tier per owner directive 2026-11-05; tailnet: Tailscale Service svc:sketchlab (https://sketchlab.<tailnet>.ts.net, node tagged tag:server; the old serve :8447 door retired)

services.name: hyperframes
services.note: built locally from ~/workspace/github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes at upstream commit f70dce7

services.name: hermes
services.note: opt-in (install.sh --with-hermes); this host runs Hermes natively (hermes-gateway.service), so the container is not deployed by default

services.name: prometheus
services.note: metrics store + OTLP receiver; scrapes every service on systemd-ai via file_sd from scripts/render-prometheus.py; retention 180d/20GB; UI 127.0.0.1:3107; starts at boot (monitoring tier exception)

services.name: grafana
services.note: dashboards + alerts, LAN with login (admin password from generate-secrets.sh); provisioning and dashboards mounted read-only from the repo monitoring/ dir; on demand like the web apps

services.name: node-exporter
services.note: host metrics (Network=host, binds 127.0.0.1:9100 itself); rootless sees hwmon/pressure/filesystem but not systemd units (dbus)

services.name: gpu-exporter
services.note: both cards via NVML, keyed by UUID; utility-only: no registry gpu field, holds no VRAM, the arbiter ignores it

services.name: podman-exporter
services.note: container state/stats through the px user podman.sock (podman.socket user unit must be enabled); default collectors (enable-all made scrapes hang on image-size stats)

services.name: blackbox-exporter
services.note: HTTP probes of every registry health URL on systemd-ai; probe_success is the service health grid

services.name: victorialogs
services.note: log store (chosen over Loki in the 2026-10-08 bake-off: fewer moving parts, no schema/compactor config, no ingestion-limit tuning); retention 30d/5GB; Grafana via the victoriametrics-logs-datasource plugin; no host port

services.name: fluent-bit
services.note: reads px's user journal (read-only) and pushes to victorialogs; MUST NOT use --userns=keep-id (the journal ACL grants px, and container root maps to px; keep-id makes it nobody and the input silently reads 0 records); 4.2+ required (4.0 cannot read this ZSTD journal, systemd 262); no host port

services.name: nats
services.note: duplex-bus E5 event bus (JetStream on, /data volume); client port 127.0.0.1:4222; research interlude, see ~/Documents/plans/duplex-bus-experiments-plan.md

services.name: soulx-duplug
services.note: duplex-bus E1 turn-controller WS (ws://127.0.0.1:8000/turn); ASR patched to SenseVoice CPU so it coexists with voxtype; ~5.5-6.5 GB VRAM fp32; built from ~/workspace/research/duplex-bus/src/SoulX-Duplug

services.name: personaplex
services.note: duplex-bus E2 PersonaPlex 7B bnb-4bit full-duplex WS (ws://127.0.0.1:8998/api/chat); community quant path (cookertron fork, patched build); ~8 GB VRAM, pause voxtype if tight

services.name: minicpmo-omni
services.note: duplex-bus E3 MiniCPM-o 4.5 llama.cpp-omni full-duplex WS (ws://127.0.0.1:9060/backend); host-built binary mounted; ~10-10.5 GB VRAM: pause voxtype first; server binds 0.0.0.0 inside the container - loopback PublishPort only

services.name: embeddings
services.note: CPU embedding server (bge-m3 Q8_0, dense 1024) for the memory stack; own model dir ~/.local/share/ai-lab/embeddings/models (never a card dir: the GPU routers would advertise it); key from config/llama-cpp/keys.txt; in-network base_url http://systemd-embeddings:8080/v1

services.name: openviking
services.note: OpenViking shared memory backend (Hermes plugin provider); root_api_key in the rendered config/openviking/ov.conf (key also in service.env for curl); VLM = systemd-strata, embeddings = systemd-embeddings; the plugin must NEVER spawn this server (volcengine/OpenViking#5553)

services.name: honcho-database
services.note: PostgreSQL 15 + pgvector for Honcho; no host port (reachable only as systemd-honcho-database on ai.network); POSTGRES_PASSWORD + DB_CONNECTION_URI in config/honcho/service.env; data ~/.local/share/ai-lab/honcho-database

services.name: honcho-api
services.note: Honcho API (JWT auth on: AUTH_USE_AUTH=true + AUTH_JWT_SECRET from config/honcho/service.env); digest pinned the way honcho-cli pins it (latest + its manifest digest); LLM = systemd-strata (qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s), embeddings = systemd-embeddings at 1024 dim (schema needs the one-time configure_embeddings.py bootstrap, see plan); start honcho-database first

services.name: honcho-deriver
services.note: Honcho background worker (Exec python -m src.deriver, no host port; /metrics on 9090 in-network); essential for memory extraction; start after honcho-api is healthy

services.name: dufs
services.note: whole-home WebDAV + browser UI for the Mac; tailnet-only: loopback bind + tailscale serve https://ai.<tailnet>.ts.net (LE cert, 443 -> 127.0.0.1:3112); old ufw allow 3112/tcp deleted; account px, sha-512 hash in config/dufs/config.yaml, plaintext in config/dufs/service.env (DAV_PASSWORD); boots at boot (files tier)

services.name: s3-webdav
services.note: Garage buckets as WebDAV folders (rclone serve webdav over the garage: S3 remote); tailnet-only: loopback bind + tailscale serve https://ai.<tailnet>.ts.net:8449 -> 127.0.0.1:3124; account webdav, apr1 hash in config/s3-webdav/htpasswd, plaintext mirror in service.env; S3 creds mirrored from s3/service.env; boots at boot (files tier)

services.name: syncthing
services.note: home folder sync with the Mac; GUI loopback 127.0.0.1:8384 (ssh -L when headless); listener 22000 tcp+udp published for direct connect, ufw tailscale0-only; ~/.stignore excludes machine-local state; boots at boot (files tier)

services.name: vscode
services.note: VS Code Server (serve-web) in an Arch dev box; px=1000 keep-id (fish login shell), sudo inside; host podman socket mounted (distrobox-style); works in ~/.workspaces/vscode mounted at /workspace inside the container (NOT the host syncthing-synced ~/workspace; bind sources from the box are host paths); GPU devices visible via AddDevice=all but NO gpu field (deliberate: outside arbiter); loopback publish, tailnet door via tailscale serve https :8443 (real FQDN never committed)

services.name: ragflow
services.note: KB core: ingestion/DeepDoc/hybrid retrieval/chat (Go v1.x line). UI loopback 3114; REST API 9380 in-network (systemd-ragflow:9380). Secrets+endpoints config/ragflow/service.env. Group kb woken by kb-watcher.timer.

services.name: ragflow-elasticsearch
services.note: RAGFlow doc engine (single-node, xpack security on); no host port (systemd-ragflow-elasticsearch:9200); needs vm.max_map_count>=262144 (Arch default 1048576); volume kb-es-data.

services.name: ragflow-mysql
services.note: RAGFlow metadata DB (rag_flow schema via config/ragflow/init.sql); no host port (systemd-ragflow-mysql:3306); server cred config/ragflow/mysql.env (mirrors client MYSQL_PASSWORD); volume kb-mysql-data.

services.name: ragflow-minio
services.note: RAGFlow object storage (pgsty/silo, the MinIO-compatible server v1.0.0-rc3 ships); no host port (systemd-ragflow-minio:9000); volume kb-minio-data.

services.name: ragflow-kvrocks
services.note: RAGFlow Go-line cache/RunTracker backend (Redis protocol; 2.16.0 pinned for the TTL-contract fix); requirepass rendered by config/ragflow/kvrocks-entrypoint.sh from REDIS_PASSWORD; no host port; volume kb-kvrocks-data.

services.name: ragflow-nats
services.note: RAGFlow ingestion task queue (JetStream -js); no host port; distinct from the host nats duplex-bus service (systemd-nats, 4222/8222 loopback) - no collision because this publishes nothing; volume kb-nats-data.

services.name: kb-postgres
services.note: LightRAG storage (PGTableGraphStorage + PGKV + PGVector dim 1024 + PGDocStatus); separate from honcho-database on purpose (blast radius); no host port (systemd-kb-postgres:5432); volume kb-lightrag-pg-data.

services.name: lightrag
services.note: KB knowledge-graph server (exportable graph feeding W1/W2 analysis); UI+API loopback 3116; strata+bge-m3 wired in config/lightrag/service.env; embedding dim 1024 FROZEN at table creation.

services.name: kb-watcher
services.note: Nightly corpus ingestion one-shot (plan sec.4): sha256 manifest diff over ~/workspace+~/Documents -> RAGFlow upload+parse, LightRAG mirror, tombstones; reports+state in repo kb/ dir (gitignored); activated by systemd/kb-watcher.timer.

services.name: kb-analysis
services.note: W1-W4 deterministic helper (pair queue verdicts RAGFlow tagging report rendering); called by the Windmill W1-W4 scripts over ai.network at systemd-kb-analysis:8090; shares the kb-watcher image; state in repo kb/ dir (gitignored)

services.name: windmill-postgres
services.note: Windmill state + job queue (all state in PG, compose default pg18); separate from kb-postgres on purpose (blast radius/backup lifecycle); no host port (systemd-windmill-postgres:5432); volume wm-db-data.

services.name: windmill-server
services.note: Windmill automation server (UI+API; replaces n8n per owner directive 2026-11-05, windmill-jupyter plan P0); MODE=server; SUPERADMIN_SECRET bootstrap; tailnet door svc:windmill; env config/windmill/service.env.

services.name: windmill-worker
services.note: Windmill default-group worker; bare-container sandbox (nsjail default off, no privileged - single trusted operator, revisit for team); CPU-only; volume wm-worker-cache.

services.name: notebook
services.note: Notebook server (JupyterLab + marimo-jupyter-extension, windmill-jupyter plan P2): CPU-only kernels, notebooks in ~/workspace/notebooks (own git repo, same-path mount), token file config/notebook/jupyter-token; VS Code boxes attach as existing Jupyter server; tailnet door planned svc:notebook; volume notebook-state.

services.name: ailab-api
services.note: AI Lab control API, macOS menu-bar widget backend (mac-quadlet-widget plan P0): status/start/stop/toggle/restart + variant switches + arbiter dry-run plans, all delegating to scripts/ai-lab so gpu-arbiter.py is always in the loop. Network=host quadlet binding 127.0.0.1:3119; tailnet door https://ai.<tailnet>.ts.net:8448 (tailscale serve, LE cert); bearer token config/ailab-api/service.env; repo mounted ro + %t/bus session-bus socket for systemctl --user (private socket unusable across pidns). Boot tier (owner directive 2026-11-10: all functionality from the tailnet).

services.name: forge
services.note: Forgejo git forge (agentic-pipeline plan): git remote for Concourse git resources. Web loopback 3120, tailnet door svc:forge; SECOND publish 0.0.0.0:2223->22 for git SSH (host has no nft ruleset - LAN-reachable, flagged at enable; not the first PublishPort so registry check covers web only). Volumes forge-data (/data) + forge-ssh (SSH host keys); entrypoint runs as ns-root (no keep-id - s6 verified live), volumes pre-chowned 1000:1000 by pipeline-bootstrap.sh; DB = forge-postgres sidecar; admin bootstrap via forgejo CLI (scripts/pipeline-bootstrap.sh). Repo dormant by default; boot activation via live drop-in (plan sec.8.6).

services.name: forge-postgres
services.note: Forgejo DB (state: users/repos/issues; agentic-pipeline plan); separate instance for blast-radius split (kb-postgres precedent); no host port (systemd-forge-pg:5432); volume forge-db-data (PG18 parent-dir mount, docker-library/postgres#1259).

services.name: s3
services.note: Garage S3 object storage, single node (agentic-pipeline plan; MinIO rejected - archived upstream): artifact bucket ci-artifacts for Concourse s3 resources (path-style, plain HTTP, region garage). Loopback 3121 for host CLIs + svc:s3 door; admin via podman exec /garage CLI (3902/3903 unpublished). Volumes garage-data/garage-meta; config/s3/garage.toml (600). ragflow-minio stays MinIO (RAGFlow pins it).

services.name: concourse-web
services.note: Concourse v8.3.3 web (ATC+TSA+UI) - orchestrator of the agentic pipeline (plan): production-shape web+worker pair (not quickstart: regenerates state per boot). Loopback 3122 + svc:concourse door (external URL kept at URL root - websocket-heavy). TSA :2222 in-network only. Keys config/concourse/keys/ (ro bind, on-target generated); local users pipeline (main team) + agent (restricted) in web.env; DB = concourse-postgres.

services.name: concourse-worker
services.note: Concourse v8.3.3 worker (agentic-pipeline plan): privileged (PodmanArgs --privileged --cgroupns=host; nested containerd/overlay; no native Privileged= quadlet key in podman 6.1.4 - man-verified), StopSignal=SIGUSR2 (graceful drain). Reaches TSA in-network systemd-concourse-web:2222. Task containers get sibling DNS via CONTAINERD_DNS_SERVER=10.89.0.1 + ALLOW_HOST_ACCESS=true (running-worker doc pair). Volume concourse-worker-state:/worker-state (image ENV CONCOURSE_WORK_DIR). Inner CNI pool 10.80.0.0/16 NATs through the worker.

services.name: concourse-postgres
services.note: Concourse ATC DB (pipeline runs/jobs state; agentic-pipeline plan; Concourse requires PG>=11): separate instance, blast-radius split; no host port (systemd-concourse-pg:5432); DB/user atc (running-postgres doc default); volume concourse-db-data (PG18 parent-dir mount).

services.name: concourse-mcp
services.note: Thin MCP server (streamable HTTP /mcp) over the Concourse ATC REST API (agentic-pipeline plan sec.2.4; no usable upstream MCP exists): list/set pipelines, trigger/status/abort builds, resources pin/unpin, jobs, workers. Two static bearer tokens map to teams: Hermes-grade -> pipeline(main), low-priv -> agent; in-pipeline tasks use it at http://systemd-concourse-mcp:8080/mcp (same worker-DNS path as forge/S3). Hermes host config: url http://127.0.0.1:3123/mcp. Built image (no digest pin), source containers/concourse-mcp/.

services.name: max-face
services.note: Audio2Face-3D NIM single-stream (batch-1 TRT engines, ~0.9 GB VRAM per NVIDIA edge config); gRPC on systemd-max-face:52000 ai.network only; needs NGC_API_KEY in config/max-face/service.env; first start builds engines (volume max-face-cache)

services.name: max-bridge
services.note: blendshape fan-out WS hub (ws :8990 /feed /shapes, protocol {hello,names}+{t,bs}); bridges clients to max-face NIM (sync grpc, nvidia_ace 1.2.0); v2 avatar plan

services.name: maxface
services.note: ticket-07 learned-face renderer (QuickTalk/opentalking on CUDA): ws systemd-maxface:8993 /frames JPEG + /audio-in PCM push, ai.network only; plexpipe relays as 'V' when skin=quicktalk (mannequin=maxvid fallback); ~1.5-2 GB VRAM beside personaplex on the 4070 Ti

services.name: plexpipe
services.note: MaxPresence P0 door bridge (ws :8991, one Mac session; JSON ctrl + binary 'A'/'V'); 48k uplink -> ffmpeg 24k -> sphn Ogg/Opus -> systemd-personaplex:8998; downlink -> 'A' + systemd-max-bridge /feed; tailnet door tailscale serve :8457 (docs/mac-virtual-devices-plan.md)

services.name: tyger-gateway
services.note: V03 door gateway: answers the `plex` role plexpipe dials (WS /api/chat, one-byte handshake, 0x01+Ogg/Opus 24 kHz) and speaks tyger-s2s's EARS /ws at ws://tyger-v1:7860/ws -- mic blocks tagged [rid][agent sample at 24 kHz] at 16 kHz, replies 24 kHz, played:<rid>:<samples> reports; GET /health is 200 only with a real tyger behind it (plexpipe ExecStartPre gate); container README + WIRE-TABLES-v03.md carry the contracts

services.name: maxvid
services.note: MaxPresence P2 video renderer (V-6a): headless chromium (SwiftShader, CPU-only) of the max-headroom v2 app at 640x480; CDP paced screenshots -> ws :8992 /frames -> plexpipe relays as 'V'; app served from apps/max-headroom/dist volume; chromium starts/stops with subscriber demand
